name: ada-dev-cli
description: Cardano development CLI — local devnet, wallets, balances, transfers, native assets and atomic swaps from one command surface. Testnets only.
author: nel349

scripts.build: bun build src/ada.ts --outfile dist/ada.js --target node --format esm --packages external --banner "#!/usr/bin/env node" && bun build src/mcp-server.ts --outfile dist/mcp-server.js --target node --format esm --packages external --banner "#!/usr/bin/env node"
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
